summary: Tracks image blobs with OpenCV and exposes blob ids, coordinates, sizes, and counts through Info DAT/CHOP outputs.

key_params.name: monosource
key_params.note: Monochrome source channel such as luminance, RGBA channels, or rgb average

key_params.name: drawblobs
key_params.note: Draw tracked blob overlays into the TOP output

key_params.name: blobcolor
key_params.note: Color used for drawn blob overlays

key_params.name: downloadtype
key_params.note: GPU download mode: immediate or delayed

key_params.name: maxmovedistance
key_params.note: Maximum distance to match a blob across frames

key_params.name: deletenearby
key_params.note: Delete blobs that are too close to another blob

key_params.name: reviveblobs
key_params.note: Revive recently lost blobs when matching data returns

common_gotchas: SimpleBlobDetector can be slow and reports square-style bounds for detected regions.
Background-subtraction tracking needs a stable background input but is much faster.
Delayed download avoids GPU stalls but reports previous-frame tracking output.
Non-Commercial license limits blob tracking to two blobs.
key_concepts: Blob Track TOP uses OpenCV to detect and track blobs in image input.
The first input path uses SimpleBlobDetector; adding a second input enables background-subtraction tracking.
Tracking results are read from Info DAT and Info CHOP channels such as num_blobs rather than from image pixels alone.
Monochrome TOP and Luma Level TOP are common preprocessors for producing clean blob masks.
Download Type controls immediate GPU readback versus delayed previous-frame data.
Non-Commercial licenses are limited to tracking two blobs; Commercial and Pro can track unlimited blobs.
